title: Demand Curvature and Pass-Through in Multiproduct Oligopoly
abstract: arXiv:2604.21423v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Economic interventions change firms' pricing incentives, but their effects depend on how those incentives propagate across products and firms. This paper develops tractable characterizations of that propagation under multiproduct Bertrand competition. A decomposition of the pricing system isolates demand curvature, substitution, and ownership, linking the equilibrium response matrix to commonly used empirical demand models. It yields approximations with explicit error bounds and separates individual adjustment from equilibrium feedback. Small-share limits reveal when interactions disappear and when substitution within nests or selection among heterogeneous consumers preserves them. For nested logit, a closed-form response reduces the limiting product-level system to averages within firm--nest groups, exposing the direction of price spillovers. The same framework organizes local responses to changes in costs, demand, and ownership. Th

translated_title: 多产品寡头垄断中的需求曲率与成本传导
translated_abstract: 经济干预会改变企业的定价激励，但其效果取决于这些激励如何在产品与企业之间传播。本文在多产品伯特兰竞争下，对这种传播机制发展了易于处理的刻画方法。通过对定价系统进行分解，该方法隔离出需求曲率、替代关系和所有权结构，将均衡响应矩阵与常用的实证需求模型联系起来。它给出了具有明确误差界的近似，并将个体调整与均衡反馈分离开来。小市场份额极限揭示了产品间互动何时消失，以及在何种情况下巢内替代或异质性消费者之间的选择会保留这些互动。对于嵌套logit模型，闭式响应将极限状态下的产品层面系统简化为企业-巢组内的平均值，从而揭示了价格溢出的方向。同一框架还系统地组织了对成本、需求和所有权变化的局部响应分析。
tldr: 本文通过分解多产品伯特兰竞争下的定价系统，将需求曲率、替代关系和所有权结构与均衡响应矩阵联系起来，提供了具有明确误差界的近似方法和嵌套logit的闭式解，从而刻画了经济干预如何通过价格在产品与企业间传导。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a tractable framework that decomposes the pricing system in multiproduct Bertrand competition, linking demand curvature, substitution, and ownership to equilibrium response matrices with explicit error bounds and closed-form solutions for nested logit, thereby characterizing how economic interventions propagate through prices across products and firms.
